fields.reasoning: The change set's intent asks session done to skip picks a Decision in the change set already answers. Decisions already have a question field (internal/op/fields.go) and session interview already holds each question verbatim (internal/api/session_interview.go), so an exact match needs no new link type or schema and is deterministic. Skipping all capture whenever the planner wrote any Source-linked Decision is coarser and would drop picks the planner did not record, losing owner answers, which is worse than an occasional duplicate. Covering the landed case through derived-from the session's Source keeps it correct when the change set lands early. Requiring planners to copy the question verbatim is a cheap guide rule that makes the match reliable.
fields.statement: session interview/session done skips an AskUserQuestion answer when a live Decision the change set created (or, once the change set has landed, a landed Decision derived-from this session's Source) has a question field equal to the asked question verbatim; only answers with no such Decision become answer-<sid8>-N Decisions. The planner guide tells planners who record an answer themselves to copy the asked question text verbatim into the Decision's question field.
